description: This file defines endpoint configurations and helper functions for the CompareUI component, including endpoint identifiers, configurations, and utility functions for handling models and agents.

methods.name: getAvailableEndpoints
methods.description: Returns a list of available endpoint configurations for dropdown selection.

methods.name: getEndpointConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration object for a given endpoint ID.

methods.name: isAgentEndpoint
methods.description: Checks if the specified endpoint uses the 'agent' selector type.

methods.name: isModelEndpoint
methods.description: Checks if the specified endpoint uses the 'model' selector type.

methods.name: modelOptionsToSelectorOptions
methods.description: Converts a list of model strings to SelectorOption objects.

methods.name: agentOptionsToSelectorOptions
methods.description: Converts a list of Agent objects to SelectorOption objects.

methods.name: getSelectionFieldName
methods.description: Returns 'model' or 'agent' based on the endpoint's selector type.

methods.name: getComparisonSelection
methods.description: Gets the selected value ('model' or 'agent') from a comparison object based on endpoint.

methods.name: hasValidSelection
methods.description: Checks if the comparison object has a valid selection for the specified endpoint.
